subject: Emergency purge request — prompts & log artifacts (Acme Payments / project 'vault')
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@acme-payments.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Legal <legal@acme-payments.com>, HubSpot-CRM <crm+acme_4321@hubspot.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: immediate purge of prompts/outputs/logs for project 'vault'

Hi Diego,

We discovered a set of sensitive customer prompts and derivative outputs stored under our project "vault" that need to be purged immediately under our contract (see Section 4.3). Can you confirm Redwood's process for:

- Identifying all stored prompt inputs and generated outputs tied to project id: vault-ACME-2024
- Removing KV cache and any transient storage of prompt tokens
- Purging inference request logs (timestamps, request IDs) related to those sessions
- Providing verifiable proof of deletion (manifest + checksums or presigned evidence link)

We need a proposed timeline and the list of artifacts you will provide for our audit. Please include a named contact for the execution window — Acme will require legal sign-off on the confirmation artifact.

Thanks,
Emma Jones
Head of Platform Risk
Acme Payments
emma.jones@acme-payments.com

--
Attachment: acme_deletion_request_20270601.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: immediate purge of prompts/outputs/logs for project 'vault'

Emma — thanks for the clear ask. We can execute a targeted purge; below is the proposed mutual action plan (MAP) and estimated timing. Once Acme confirms scope and appoints an approver from Legal, we will schedule the run in our Dedicated purge window.

Planned steps (high level):
1) Scope validation (2 hours): map project id vault-ACME-2024 to model-serving routes, cache keys, and storage buckets.
2) Quiesce writes (30 min): pause new writes for the project to prevent re-ingest during purge.
3) Purge pass (3–4 hours): 
   - Delete prompt/output artifacts from short-term stores and persistent blob storage (S3) with lifecycle override.
   - Remove KV cache entries and associated keyed caches on serving nodes.
   - Wipe request logs at the application layer that are covered by the deletion clause (we will not remove audit logs needed for compliance unless explicitly authorized).
4) Verification pass (1 hour): produce a purge manifest (CSV), hashed entries removed, and a signed confirmation PDF.
5) Delivery (within 24 hours of execution): presigned evidence link + manifest + Redwood-signed certificate (redwood_purge_cert_20270607.pdf).

Deliverables:
- acme_purge_manifest_20270607.csv (list of deleted keys + object ids)
- redwood_purge_cert_20270607.pdf (signed by Redwood infosec)
- presigned S3 evidence file (30-day link)

Risks / notes:
- Application-level request logs used for customer billing will be retained unless Acme explicitly authorizes removal (billing reconciliation risk).
- If deletion requires changing retention for underlying audit logs, we will need Legal approval from both sides.

Please confirm: (a) Authorization from Acme Legal to proceed, and (b) preferred blackout window (UTC). Once confirmed we'll lock a 4–6 hour window and share the runbook.

— Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Emma Jones <emma.jones@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: immediate purge of prompts/outputs/logs for project 'vault'

Hi Emma / Diego — looping in operations. A few execution details from the Dedicated team:

- We will take a snapshot of meta-indexes prior to deletion and retain a signed digest locally for 90 days to support dispute resolution; the snapshot will not contain raw prompt/response content.
- Purge will be executed node-by-node and we will surface a per-shard manifest.
- Expected total wall-clock time for the purge: ~4 hours. We can start as soon as we have written authorization from Acme Legal.

Quick ask for Acme Legal to reply with this single-line approval: 
"Acme Legal authorizes Redwood to delete prompts, outputs, and inference logs associated with vault-ACME-2024 and accepts Redwood's retention of deletion digests for 90 days."

Attachment: proposed_purge_runbook_v1.pdf (pdf stub)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Manager, Customer Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Acme Legal <legal@acme-payments.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Jones <emma.jones@acme-payments.com>, HubSpot-CRM <crm+acme_4321@hubspot.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T14:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: immediate purge of prompts/outputs/logs for project 'vault'

Monica / Diego — Acme Legal approves the purge with the following condition: Redwood may retain signed deletion digests for 90 days but must not retain any raw prompt or output content. Approval statement: 

"Acme Legal authorizes Redwood to delete prompts, outputs, and inference logs associated with vault-ACME-2024. Acme accepts Redwood's retention of deletion digests for 90 days; no raw content may be retained."

Please proceed and provide the manifests and the presigned evidence link to legal@acme-payments.com when complete.

Regards,
Sarah Patel
Senior Counsel — Acme Payments
legal@acme-payments.com

Deliverables (attached / linked):
